"'''Credman'''" was the alias of a weapons [[Collector/Legends|collector]] active by the date [[9 ABY/Legends|44:9:4:85]], who was a commentator on items sold in [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]]. Credman spent several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Guiteica/Legends|Guiteica]], learning the method for creating [[dematoil]]s, which were [[Morningstar (weapon)|morningstars]] wielded by the native [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrians]]. Credman was able to create the basic ball and chain, but believed they would never be able to touch one that had quills attached. Credman was, however, willing to pay a lot of money to anyone selling a dematoil with quills attached, no questions asked.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

Credman was also the owner of a [[rantok]], which the collector had found. Despite being offered tens of thousands of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], Credman refused to sell it because of its rarity. Credman noted that the weapon was unwieldy to use but with practice it was a formidable weapon.<ref name="GFT" />

Credman also commented on several other entries, including the [[Taser stave|taser staff]], the [[Sevari Flashpistol]], and the [[StarAnvil heavy blaster rifle]].<ref name="GFT" />
